label: Bible Study
prompt: Pilate saith unto him, What is _____? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verse: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
note: Pilate's famous question — asked of the one who had said, 'I am the way, the truth, and the life.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not _____.
verse: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
note: God's open treasury: rain in season, work blessed, and the rare promise to lend and never borrow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden _____, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verse: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
note: The KJV's 'cherubims' doubles up the plural — cherub plus Hebrew -im plus English -s — guarding Eden's gate with a flaming sword.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a _____ stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
note: God's foundation stone for Zion — Peter applies it to Jesus in 1 Peter 2:6.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and _____ evil?
verse: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
note: God's own résumé for Job: perfect, upright, fearing God, and one that 'escheweth evil' — turns his back on it.
